  have h_step1 : List.cons (sem.div (sem.mul a b) b) (elementwiseDiv sem (elementwiseMul sem as bs) bs) = List.cons a (elementwiseDiv sem (elementwiseMul sem as bs) bs) := congrArg (fun x => List.cons x (elementwiseDiv sem (elementwiseMul sem as bs) bs)) h_head
  have h_step2 : List.cons a (elementwiseDiv sem (elementwiseMul sem as bs) bs) = List.cons a as := congrArg (List.cons a) h_tail
  Eq.trans h_step1 h_step2
| [], b::bs, h => nomatch h
| a::as, [], h => nomatch h

def forwardRow {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (dim : Nat) (cmin cmax : N) (sw tw sb tb x1 x2 : List N) : List N × List N :=
  let scale := computeScaleRow sem dim cmin cmax sw sb x2
  let y1 := elementwiseMul sem x1 scale
  let trans := computeTranslationRow sem dim tw tb y1
  let y2 := elementwiseAdd sem x2 trans
  (y1, y2)

def inverseRow {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (dim : Nat) (cmin cmax : N) (sw tw sb tb y1 y2 : List N) : List N × List N :=
  let trans := computeTranslationRow sem dim tw tb y1
  let x2 := elementwiseSub sem y2 trans
  let scale := computeScaleRow sem dim cmin cmax sw sb x2
  let x1 := elementwiseDiv sem y1 scale
  (x1, x2)

theorem pair_eq {α β : Type} {a c : α} {b d : β} (h1 : a = c) (h2 : b = d) : (a, b) = (c, d) :=
  have s1 : (a, b) = (c, b) := congrArg (fun x => (x, b)) h1
  have s2 : (c, b) = (c, d) := congrArg (fun y => (c, y)) h2
  Eq.trans s1 s2

theorem inverseRow_forwardRow {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (dim : Nat) (cmin cmax : N) (sw tw sb tb x1 x2 : List N)
  (h_len1 : x1.length = (computeScaleRow sem dim cmin cmax sw sb x2).length)
  (h_len2 : x2.length = (computeTranslationRow sem dim tw tb (elementwiseMul sem x1 (computeScaleRow sem dim cmin cmax sw sb x2))).length) :
  inverseRow sem dim cmin cmax sw tw sb tb (forwardRow sem dim cmin cmax sw tw sb tb x1 x2).1 (forwardRow sem dim cmin cmax sw tw sb tb x1 x2).2 = (x1, x2) :=
  let scale := computeScaleRow sem dim cmin cmax sw sb x2
  let y1 := elementwiseMul sem x1 scale
  let trans := computeTranslationRow sem dim tw tb y1
  let y2 := elementwiseAdd sem x2 trans
  have h_x2 : elementwiseSub sem y2 trans = x2 := elementwiseSub_add_cancel sem x2 trans h_len2
  have h_scale : computeScaleRow sem dim cmin cmax sw sb (elementwiseSub sem y2 trans) = scale := congrArg (computeScaleRow sem dim cmin cmax sw sb) h_x2
  have h_x1_step1 : elementwiseDiv sem y1 (computeScaleRow sem dim cmin cmax sw sb (elementwiseSub sem y2 trans)) = elementwiseDiv sem y1 scale :=
    congrArg (elementwiseDiv sem y1) h_scale
  have h_x1_step2 : elementwiseDiv sem y1 scale = x1 := elementwiseDiv_mul_cancel sem x1 scale h_len1
  have h_x1 : elementwiseDiv sem y1 (computeScaleRow sem dim cmin cmax sw sb (elementwiseSub sem y2 trans)) = x1 := Eq.trans h_x1_step1 h_x1_step2
  pair_eq h_x1 h_x2

def splitInto {N : Type} : Nat → List N → List N × List N
| 0, xs => ([], xs)
| Nat.succ n, [] => ([], [])
| Nat.succ n, x::xs =>
  let (l1, l2) := splitInto n xs
  (x::l1, l2)

def mergeFrom {N : Type} : List N → List N → List N
| [], ys => ys
| x::xs, ys => x :: mergeFrom xs ys

theorem merge_split_roundtrip {N : Type} : ∀ (n : Nat) (x : List N), mergeFrom (splitInto n x).1 (splitInto n x).2 = x
| 0, xs => rfl
| Nat.succ n, [] => rfl
| Nat.succ n, x::xs => congrArg (List.cons x) (merge_split_roundtrip n xs)

def processBatchForward {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (dim : Nat) (cmin cmax : N) (sw tw sb tb : List N) : List N → List N → List N × List N
| [], [] => ([], [])
| x1, x2 =>
  let (x1_row, x1_rest) := splitInto dim x1
  let (x2_row, x2_rest) := splitInto dim x2
  let (y1_row, y2_row) := forwardRow sem dim cmin cmax sw tw sb tb x1_row x2_row
  let (y1_rest, y2_rest) := processBatchForward sem dim cmin cmax sw tw sb tb x1_rest x2_rest
  (mergeFrom y1_row y1_rest, mergeFrom y2_row y2_rest)

def processBatchInverse {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (dim : Nat) (cmin cmax : N) (sw tw sb tb : List N) : List N → List N → List N × List N
| [], [] => ([], [])
| y1, y2 =>
  let (y1_row, y1_rest) := splitInto dim y1
  let (y2_row, y2_rest) := splitInto dim y2
  let (x1_row, x2_row) := inverseRow sem dim cmin cmax sw tw sb tb y1_row y2_row
  let (x1_rest, x2_rest) := processBatchInverse sem dim cmin cmax sw tw sb tb y1_rest y2_rest
  (mergeFrom x1_row x1_rest, mergeFrom x2_row x2_rest)

def forwardInPlace {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (layer : LayerCore N) (x1 x2 : Tensor N) : RSFResult (Tensor N × Tensor N) :=
  match tensorsOverlap x1 x2 with
  | true => Except.error RSFError.AliasedBuffers
  | false =>
    let (y1_data, y2_data) := processBatchForward sem layer.dim layer.clip_min layer.clip_max layer.s_weight.data layer.t_weight.data layer.s_bias.data layer.t_bias.data x1.data x2.data
    Except.ok ({ x1 with data := y1_data }, { x2 with data := y2_data })

def inverseInPlace {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (layer : LayerCore N) (y1 y2 : Tensor N) : RSFResult (Tensor N × Tensor N) :=
  match tensorsOverlap y1 y2 with
  | true => Except.error RSFError.AliasedBuffers
  | false =>
    let (x1_data, x2_data) := processBatchInverse sem layer.dim layer.clip_min layer.clip_max layer.s_weight.data layer.t_weight.data layer.s_bias.data layer.t_bias.data y1.data y2.data
    Except.ok ({ y1 with data := x1_data }, { y2 with data := x2_data })

def addFlatVectors {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) : List N → List N → List N
| [], _ => []
| _, [] => []
| a::as, b::bs => sem.add a b :: addFlatVectors sem as bs

def scaleFlatVector {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (s : N) : List N → List N
| [] => []
| x::xs => sem.mul x s :: scaleFlatVector sem s xs

def computeDsRow {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (cmin cmax : N) : List N → List N → List N → List N
| [], _, _ => []
| _, [], _ => []
| _, _, [] => []
| p::ps, d::ds, y::ys => sem.mul (sem.deriv_gate p cmin cmax) (sem.mul d y) :: computeDsRow sem cmin cmax ps ds ys

def addGradOuterProductReal {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (dim : Nat) (grad_scale : N) (col_vec row_vec target_mat : List N) : Nat → List N
| 0 => target_mat
| Nat.succ d =>
  let r := dim - Nat.succ d
  let c_val := match dropFlat r col_vec with | [] => sem.zero | x::_ => x
  let scaled_row := scaleFlatVector sem (sem.mul c_val grad_scale) row_vec
  let target_row := extractRow target_mat r dim
  let new_row := addFlatVectors sem target_row scaled_row
  let rec insertRow (n : Nat) (mat : List N) (nrow : List N) : List N :=
    match n, mat, nrow with
    | 0, m, [] => m
    | 0, m::ms, r::rs => r :: insertRow 0 ms rs
    | Nat.succ k, m::ms, r_lst => m :: insertRow k ms r_lst
    | _, [], _ => []
  let next_mat := insertRow (r * dim) target_mat new_row
  addGradOuterProductReal sem dim grad_scale col_vec row_vec next_mat d

def addGradOuterProduct {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (dim : Nat) (grad_scale : N) (col_vec row_vec target_mat : List N) : List N :=
  addGradOuterProductReal sem dim grad_scale col_vec row_vec target_mat dim

def backwardFromOutputsRow {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (dim : Nat) (cmin cmax : N) (sw tw sb tb y1 y2 dy1 dy2 : List N) (grad_scale : N) (tw_grad_in tb_grad_in sw_grad_in sb_grad_in : List N) : List N × List N × List N × List N × List N × List N × List N :=
  let dy1_total := elementwiseAdd sem dy1 (computeTranslationRow sem dim tw tb dy2)
  let trans := computeTranslationRow sem dim tw tb y1
  let x2_out := elementwiseSub sem y2 trans
  
  let rec computePreactReal (n : Nat) : List N :=
    match n with
    | 0 => []
    | Nat.succ d =>
      let r := dim - Nat.succ d
      let s_row := extractRow sw r dim
      let b_val := match dropFlat r sb with | [] => sem.zero | x::_ => x
      sem.add b_val (dotProduct sem s_row x2_out) :: computePreactReal d
  let preact := let rec rev_acc (l : List N) (acc : List N) : List N := match l with | [] => acc | x::xs => rev_acc xs (x::acc) in rev_acc (computePreactReal dim) []
  
  let clipped := preact.map (fun v => sem.clip v cmin cmax)
  let scale := clipped.map sem.exp
  let x1_out := elementwiseDiv sem y1 scale
  let dx1_out := elementwiseMul sem dy1_total scale
  let ds := computeDsRow sem cmin cmax preact dy1_total y1
  let dx2_out := elementwiseAdd sem dy2 (computeTranslationRow sem dim sw sb ds)
  
  let tw_grad_out := addGradOuterProduct sem dim grad_scale dy2 y1 tw_grad_in
  let tb_grad_out := addFlatVectors sem tb_grad_in (scaleFlatVector sem grad_scale dy2)
  let sw_grad_out := addGradOuterProduct sem dim grad_scale ds x2_out sw_grad_in
  let sb_grad_out := addFlatVectors sem sb_grad_in (scaleFlatVector sem grad_scale ds)
  
  (dx1_out, dx2_out, ds, tw_grad_out, tb_grad_out, sw_grad_out, sb_grad_out)

def processBatchBackward {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (dim : Nat) (cmin cmax : N) (sw tw sb tb : List N) (grad_scale : N) : List N → List N → List N → List N → List N → List N → List N → List N → List N × List N × List N × List N × List N × List N
| [], [], [], [], twg, tbg, swg, sbg => ([], [], twg, tbg, swg, sbg)
| y1, y2, dy1, dy2, twg, tbg, swg, sbg =>
  let (y1_row, y1_rest) := splitInto dim y1
  let (y2_row, y2_rest) := splitInto dim y2
  let (dy1_row, dy1_rest) := splitInto dim dy1
  let (dy2_row, dy2_rest) := splitInto dim dy2
  let (dx1_row, dx2_row, _, twg_next, tbg_next, swg_next, sbg_next) := backwardFromOutputsRow sem dim cmin cmax sw tw sb tb y1_row y2_row dy1_row dy2_row grad_scale twg tbg swg sbg
  let (dx1_rest, dx2_rest, twg_final, tbg_final, swg_final, sbg_final) := processBatchBackward sem dim cmin cmax sw tw sb tb grad_scale y1_rest y2_rest dy1_rest dy2_rest twg_next tbg_next swg_next sbg_next
  (mergeFrom dx1_row dx1_rest, mergeFrom dx2_row dx2_rest, twg_final, tbg_final, swg_final, sbg_final)

def validateBackwardIO {N : Type} (grad_output input output : Tensor N) (dim dim2 : Nat) : RSFResult Nat :=
  match validateTensor2D grad_output, validateTensor2D input, validateTensor2D output with
  | Except.ok _, Except.ok _, Except.ok _ =>
    match Nat.beq input.shape.dims.length 2, Nat.beq grad_output.shape.dims.length 2, Nat.beq output.shape.dims.length 2 with
    | true, true, true =>
      let b := input.shape.dims.head!
      match Nat.beq grad_output.shape.dims.head! b, Nat.beq output.shape.dims.head! b with
      | true, true =>
        match Nat.beq input.shape.dims.tail!.head! dim2, Nat.beq grad_output.shape.dims.tail!.head! dim2, Nat.beq output.shape.dims.tail!.head! dim2 with
        | true, true, true =>
          match Nat.beq b 0 with
          | false => Except.ok b
          | true => Except.error RSFError.InvalidBatchSize
        | _, _, _ => Except.error RSFError.ShapeMismatch
      | _, _ => Except.error RSFError.ShapeMismatch
    | _, _, _ => Except.error RSFError.ShapeMismatch
  | Except.error e, _, _ => Except.error e
  | _, Except.error e, _ => Except.error e
  | _, _, Except.error e => Except.error e

structure RegistryEntry (Core : Type) where
  core : Core
  active_ops : Nat
  destroyed : Bool

structure Registry (Core : Type) where
  entries : List (Nat × RegistryEntry Core)
  next_id : Nat

def registerRegistryCore {Core : Type} (reg : Registry Core) (core : Core) : Registry Core × Nat :=
  let id := reg.next_id
  let new_entry := { core := core, active_ops := 0, destroyed := false : RegistryEntry Core }
  ({ entries := (id, new_entry) :: reg.entries, next_id := id + 1 }, id)

def lookupEntry {Core : Type} : Nat → List (Nat × RegistryEntry Core) → Option (RegistryEntry Core)
| _, [] => none
| k, (k', v) :: rest =>
  match Nat.beq k k' with
  | true => some v
  | false => lookupEntry k rest

def acquireRegistryCore {Core : Type} (reg : Registry Core) (id : Nat) : RSFResult Core :=
  match id with
  | 0 => Except.error RSFError.NotInitialized
  | Nat.succ _ =>
    match lookupEntry id reg.entries with
    | none => Except.error RSFError.NotInitialized
    | some entry =>
      match entry.destroyed with
      | true => Except.error RSFError.NotInitialized
      | false => Except.ok entry.core

def releaseRegistryCore {Core : Type} (reg : Registry Core) (id : Nat) : Registry Core × Option Core :=
  match id with
  | 0 => (reg, none)
  | Nat.succ _ =>
    let rec update (es : List (Nat × RegistryEntry Core)) : List (Nat × RegistryEntry Core) × Option Core :=
      match es with
      | [] => ([], none)
      | (k, v) :: rest =>
        match Nat.beq k id with
        | true =>
          let new_ops := match v.active_ops with | 0 => 0 | Nat.succ n => n
          match v.destroyed, new_ops with
          | true, 0 => (rest, some v.core)
          | _, _ => ((k, { v with active_ops := new_ops }) :: rest, none)
        | false =>
          let (r, c) := update rest
          ((k, v) :: r, c)
    let (new_entries, core_to_destroy) := update reg.entries
    ({ reg with entries := new_entries }, core_to_destroy)

def requestDestroyRegistryCore {Core : Type} (reg : Registry Core) (id : Nat) : Registry Core × Option Core :=
  match id with
  | 0 => (reg, none)
  | Nat.succ _ =>
    let rec update (es : List (Nat × RegistryEntry Core)) : List (Nat × RegistryEntry Core) × Option Core :=
      match es with
      | [] => ([], none)
      | (k, v) :: rest =>
        match Nat.beq k id with
        | true =>
          match v.active_ops with
          | 0 => (rest, some v.core)
          | _ => ((k, { v with destroyed := true }) :: rest, none)
        | false =>
          let (r, c) := update rest
          ((k, v) :: r, c)
    let (new_entries, core_to_destroy) := update reg.entries
    ({ reg with entries := new_entries }, core_to_destroy)

theorem acquire_zero_fails {Core : Type} (reg : Registry Core) : acquireRegistryCore reg 0 = Except.error RSFError.NotInitialized := rfl

theorem acquire_destroyed_fails {Core : Type} (reg : Registry Core) (id : Nat) (entry : RegistryEntry Core)
  (h_id : Nat.beq id 0 = false) (h_lookup : lookupEntry id reg.entries = some entry) (h_dest : entry.destroyed = true) :
  acquireRegistryCore reg id = Except.error RSFError.NotInitialized :=
  match id with
  | 0 =>
    let f (x : Bool) : Bool := x
    have h1 : f (Nat.beq 0 0) = f false := congrArg f h_id
    have h2 : f (Nat.beq 0 0) = true := rfl
    have h_contra : true = false := Eq.trans (Eq.symm h2) h1
    nomatch h_contra
  | Nat.succ n =>
    let f1 (x : Option (RegistryEntry Core)) : RSFResult Core :=
      match x with
      | none => Except.error RSFError.NotInitialized
      | some e => match e.destroyed with
                  | true => Except.error RSFError.NotInitialized
                  | false => Except.ok e.core
    have h1 : f1 (lookupEntry (Nat.succ n) reg.entries) = f1 (some entry) := congrArg f1 h_lookup
    let f2 (x : Bool) : RSFResult Core :=
      match x with
      | true => Except.error RSFError.NotInitialized
      | false => Except.ok entry.core
    have h2 : f2 entry.destroyed = f2 true := congrArg f2 h_dest
    Eq.trans h1 h2

structure RSFCore (N : Type) where
  dim : Nat
  num_layers : Nat
  layers : List (LayerCore N)
  cfg : RSFConfig N
  gpu_available : Bool
  gpu_weight_version : Nat
  cpu_weight_version : Nat

def checkedModelLayerCount {N : Type} (core : RSFCore N) : RSFResult Nat :=
  match Nat.beq core.num_layers core.layers.length with
  | false => Except.error RSFError.InvalidModelState
  | true =>
    match Nat.beq core.layers.length 0 with
    | true => Except.error RSFError.InvalidLayerCount
    | false => Except.ok core.layers.length

def applyLayersForward {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (dim : Nat) (cmin cmax : N) : List (LayerCore N) → List N → List N
| [], x => x
| layer :: rest, x =>
  let (x1, x2) := splitInto dim x
  let (y1, y2) := forwardRow sem dim cmin cmax layer.s_weight.data layer.t_weight.data layer.s_bias.data layer.t_bias.data x1 x2
  let y := mergeFrom y1 y2
  applyLayersForward sem dim cmin cmax rest y

def applyLayersInverse {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (dim : Nat) (cmin cmax : N) : List (LayerCore N) → List N → List N
| [], y => y
| layer :: rest, y =>
  let y_prev := applyLayersInverse sem dim cmin cmax rest y
  let (y1, y2) := splitInto dim y_prev
  let (x1, x2) := inverseRow sem dim cmin cmax layer.s_weight.data layer.t_weight.data layer.s_bias.data layer.t_bias.data y1 y2
  mergeFrom x1 x2

def forwardOnCore {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (core : RSFCore N) (x : Tensor N) : RSFResult (Tensor N) :=
  match validateTensor2D x with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok _ =>
    match checkedMul core.dim 2 with
    | Except.error e => Except.error e
    | Except.ok _ =>
      let y_data := applyLayersForward sem core.dim core.cfg.clip_min core.cfg.clip_max core.layers x.data
      Except.ok { x with data := y_data }

def inverseOnCore {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (core : RSFCore N) (y : Tensor N) : RSFResult (Tensor N) :=
  match validateTensor2D y with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok _ =>
    match checkedMul core.dim 2 with
    | Except.error e => Except.error e
    | Except.ok _ =>
      let x_data := applyLayersInverse sem core.dim core.cfg.clip_min core.cfg.clip_max core.layers y.data
      Except.ok { y with data := x_data }

def layerGPUCompatible {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (layer : LayerCore N) (cfg : RSFConfig N) (dim : Nat) : Bool :=
  match Nat.beq layer.dim dim with
  | false => false
  | true =>
    match sem.eq layer.clip_min cfg.clip_min with
    | false => false
    | true =>
      match sem.eq layer.clip_max cfg.clip_max with
      | false => false
      | true =>
        match layer.grad_mean == cfg.grad_mean with
        | false => false
        | true => true

theorem layerGPUCompatible_rejects_dim_mismatch {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (layer : LayerCore N) (cfg : RSFConfig N) (dim : Nat)
  (h : Nat.beq layer.dim dim = false) : layerGPUCompatible sem layer cfg dim = false :=
  let f (x : Bool) : Bool := match x with | false => false | true => match sem.eq layer.clip_min cfg.clip_min with | false => false | true => match sem.eq layer.clip_max cfg.clip_max with | false => false | true => layer.grad_mean == cfg.grad_mean
  have h1 : f (Nat.beq layer.dim dim) = f false := congrArg f h
  h1

def modelGPUCompatible {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (core : RSFCore N) : Bool :=
  match Nat.beq core.layers.length 0 with
  | true => false
  | false => true

def tryForwardGPU {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (core : RSFCore N) (x : Tensor N) : Bool × Tensor N :=
  match core.gpu_available with
  | false => (false, x)
  | true =>
    match modelGPUCompatible sem core with
    | false => (false, x)
    | true =>
      match forwardOnCore sem core x with
      | Except.ok y => (true, y)
      | Except.error _ => (false, x)

theorem gpu_fallback_equals_cpu {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (core : RSFCore N) (x : Tensor N) :
  match tryForwardGPU sem core x with
  | (true, y) => forwardOnCore sem core x = Except.ok y
  | (false, _) => True :=
  match core.gpu_available with
  | false => trivial
  | true =>
    match modelGPUCompatible sem core with
    | false => trivial
    | true =>
      match h : forwardOnCore sem core x with
      | Except.ok _ => rfl
      | Except.error _ => trivial

def crc_step_byte_loop : Nat → Nat → Nat
| 0, c => c
| Nat.succ n, c =>
  match Nat.beq (c % 2) 1 with
  | true => crc_step_byte_loop n (Nat.xor (c / 2) 3988292384)
  | false => crc_step_byte_loop n (c / 2)

def crcUpdateU8 (crc : Nat) (b : Nat) : Nat :=
  crc_step_byte_loop 8 (Nat.xor crc b)

def snapshotLayerCore {N : Type} (layer : LayerCore N) : RSFResult (LayerCore N) :=
  Except.ok { layer with s_weight_grad := none, t_weight_grad := none, s_bias_grad := none, t_bias_grad := none }

def snapshotModelForSave {N : Type} (core : RSFCore N) : RSFResult (RSFCore N) :=
  match checkedMul core.dim 2 with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok _ => Except.ok { core with gpu_available := false, gpu_weight_version := 0, cpu_weight_version := 1 }

theorem snapshotModelForSave_preserves_dim {N : Type} (core : RSFCore N) (snap : RSFCore N)
  (h : snapshotModelForSave core = Except.ok snap) : snap.dim = core.dim :=
  match h_mul : checkedMul core.dim 2 with
  | Except.error e =>
    let f (x : RSFResult (RSFCore N)) : Bool :=
      match x with
      | Except.error _ => false
      | Except.ok _ => true
    have h1 : false = f (Except.error e) := rfl
    have h2 : f (Except.error e) = f (snapshotModelForSave core) := Eq.symm (congrArg f h_mul)
    have h3 : f (snapshotModelForSave core) = f (Except.ok snap) := congrArg f h
    have h4 : f (Except.ok snap) = true := rfl
    have h_contra : false = true := Eq.trans h1 (Eq.trans h2 (Eq.trans h3 h4))
    nomatch h_contra
  | Except.ok v =>
    let f (x : RSFResult (RSFCore N)) : Nat :=
      match x with
      | Except.ok s => s.dim
      | Except.error _ => core.dim

def RSFResult (α : Type) := Except RSFError α

def RSFResult.bind {α β : Type} (x : RSFResult α) (f : α → RSFResult β) : RSFResult β :=
  match x with
  | Except.ok v => f v
  | Except.error e => Except.error e

def RSFResult.map {α β : Type} (f : α → β) (x : RSFResult α) : RSFResult β :=
  match x with
  | Except.ok v => Except.ok (f v)
  | Except.error e => Except.error e

theorem RSFResult.bind_ok {α β : Type} (v : α) (f : α → RSFResult β) : RSFResult.bind (Except.ok v) f = f v := rfl

theorem RSFResult.bind_error {α β : Type} (e : RSFError) (f : α → RSFResult β) : RSFResult.bind (Except.error e) f = Except.error e := rfl

theorem RSFResult.map_ok {α β : Type} (v : α) (f : α → β) : RSFResult.map f (Except.ok v) = Except.ok (f v) := rfl

theorem RSFResult.map_error {α β : Type} (e : RSFError) (f : α → β) : RSFResult.map f (Except.error e) = Except.error e := rfl

def maxUsize : Nat := 18446744073709551615

def maxU64 : Nat := 18446744073709551615

def checkedMul (a b : Nat) : RSFResult Nat :=
  match Nat.ble (a * b) maxUsize with
  | true => Except.ok (a * b)
  | false => Except.error RSFError.Overflow

theorem checkedMul_success (a b : Nat) (h : Nat.ble (a * b) maxUsize = true) : checkedMul a b = Except.ok (a * b) :=
  let f (x : Bool) : RSFResult Nat := match x with | true => Except.ok (a * b) | false => Except.error RSFError.Overflow
  congrArg f h

theorem checkedMul_fail (a b : Nat) (h : Nat.ble (a * b) maxUsize = false) : checkedMul a b = Except.error RSFError.Overflow :=
  let f (x : Bool) : RSFResult Nat := match x with | true => Except.ok (a * b) | false => Except.error RSFError.Overflow
  congrArg f h

def checkedAddU64 (a b : Nat) : RSFResult Nat :=
  match Nat.ble (a + b) maxU64 with
  | true => Except.ok (a + b)
  | false => Except.error RSFError.Overflow

theorem checkedAddU64_success (a b : Nat) (h : Nat.ble (a + b) maxU64 = true) : checkedAddU64 a b = Except.ok (a + b) :=
  let f (x : Bool) : RSFResult Nat := match x with | true => Except.ok (a + b) | false => Except.error RSFError.Overflow
  congrArg f h

def checkedCastU64ToUsize (v : Nat) : RSFResult Nat :=
  match Nat.ble v maxUsize with
  | true => Except.ok v
  | false => Except.error RSFError.TooLarge

structure NumericSemantics (N : Type) where
  zero : N
  one : N
  add : N → N → N
  sub : N → N → N
  mul : N → N → N
  div : N → N → N
  exp : N → N
  clip : N → N → N → N
  finite : N → Bool
  f16_convertible : N → Bool
  tol_cmp : N → N → N → N → Bool
  deriv_gate : N → N → N → N
  eq : N → N → Bool
  lt : N → N → Bool
  le : N → N → Bool
  abs : N → N
  max : N → N → N
  neg : N → N
  add_sub_cancel : ∀ a b, sub (add a b) b = a
  sub_add_cancel : ∀ a b, add (sub a b) b = a
  mul_div_cancel : ∀ a b, div (mul a b) b = a
  div_mul_cancel : ∀ a b, mul (div a b) b = a
  mul_comm : ∀ a b, mul a b = mul b a
  add_comm : ∀ a b, add a b = add b a
  mul_zero : ∀ a, mul a zero = zero
  zero_mul : ∀ a, mul zero a = zero
  add_zero : ∀ a, add a zero = a
  zero_add : ∀ a, add zero a = a

    (lt cmax v → clip v cmin cmax = cmax) ∧

    (lt p cmin → eq (deriv_gate p cmin cmax) zero) ∧
    (lt cmax p → eq (deriv_gate p cmin cmax) zero) ∧
    ((¬ lt p cmin) → (¬ lt cmax p) → eq (deriv_gate p cmin cmax) one))
  tol_cmp_spec : ∀ a b atol rtol, (finite a → finite b → finite atol → finite rtol → lt zero atol → lt zero rtol →

structure Shape where

def Shape.is2D (s : Shape) : Bool :=

  | _ :: _ :: [] => true

  data : List N
  storage_id : Nat
  offset : Nat
  len : Nat

def validateTensor2D {N : Type} (t : Tensor N) : RSFResult Unit :=
  match t.shape.dims with
  | d0 :: d1 :: [] =>
    match checkedMul d0 d1 with
    | Except.ok expected =>
      match Nat.beq t.data.length expected, Nat.beq t.len expected with
      | true, true => Except.ok ()
      | _, _ => Except.error RSFError.DataLengthMismatch
    | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | _ => Except.error RSFError.ShapeMismatch

def validateTensor2DShape {N : Type} (t : Tensor N) (rows cols : Nat) : RSFResult Unit :=
  match t.shape.dims with
  | d0 :: d1 :: [] =>
    match Nat.beq d0 rows, Nat.beq d1 cols with
    | true, true =>
      match checkedMul rows cols with
      | Except.ok expected =>
        match Nat.beq t.data.length expected, Nat.beq t.len expected with
        | true, true => Except.ok ()
        | _, _ => Except.error RSFError.DataLengthMismatch
      | Except.error e => Except.error e
    | _, _ => Except.error RSFError.ShapeMismatch
  | _ => Except.error RSFError.ShapeMismatch

def tensorsOverlap {N : Type} (a b : Tensor N) : Bool :=
  match Nat.beq a.storage_id b.storage_id with
  | false => false
  | true =>
    let a_end := a.offset + a.len
    let b_end := b.offset + b.len
    match Nat.blt a.offset b_end, Nat.blt b.offset a_end with
    | true, true => true
    | _, _ => false

def validateClipRange {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (cmin cmax : N) : RSFResult Unit :=
  match sem.finite cmin, sem.finite cmax with
  | true, true =>
    match sem.lt cmin cmax with
    | true => Except.ok ()
    | false => Except.error RSFError.InvalidConfig
  | _, _ => Except.error RSFError.NonFinite

def validateComparisonTolerances {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (abs_tol rel_tol : N) : RSFResult Unit :=
  match sem.finite abs_tol, sem.finite rel_tol with
  | true, true =>
    match sem.lt abs_tol sem.zero, sem.lt rel_tol sem.zero with
    | false, false => Except.ok ()
    | _, _ => Except.error RSFError.InvalidTolerance
  | _, _ => Except.error RSFError.InvalidTolerance

  clip_max : N
  grad_mean : Bool
  max_dim : Nat
  max_layers : Nat

  match Nat.beq dim 0, Nat.beq num_layers 0 with

    | Except.error e => Except.error e
    | Except.ok _ =>

        match Nat.ble dim cfg.max_dim, Nat.ble num_layers cfg.max_layers with
        | true, true => Except.ok ()
        | _, _ => Except.error RSFError.InvalidConfig

  let rec insert_unique (es : List (Nat × RegistryEntry Core)) : List (Nat × RegistryEntry Core) :=
    match es with
    | [] => [(id, new_entry)]
    | (k, v) :: rest => match Nat.beq k id with | true => (id, new_entry) :: rest | false => (k, v) :: insert_unique rest

def acquireRegistryCore {Core : Type} (reg : Registry Core) (id : Nat) : RSFResult Core :=
  match id with
  | 0 => Except.error RSFError.NotInitialized
  | Nat.succ _ =>
    match lookupEntry id reg.entries with
    | none => Except.error RSFError.NotInitialized
    | some entry => match entry.destroyed with | true => Except.error RSFError.NotInitialized | false => Except.ok entry.core

def releaseRegistryCore {Core : Type} (reg : Registry Core) (id : Nat) : Registry Core × Option Core :=
  match id with
  | 0 => (reg, none)
  | Nat.succ _ =>
    let rec update (es : List (Nat × RegistryEntry Core)) : List (Nat × RegistryEntry Core) × Option Core :=
      match es with
      | [] => ([], none)
      | (k, v) :: rest =>
        match Nat.beq k id with
        | true =>
          let new_ops := match v.active_ops with | 0 => 0 | Nat.succ n => n
          match v.destroyed, new_ops with
          | true, 0 => (rest, some v.core)
          | _, _ => ((k, { v with active_ops := new_ops }) :: rest, none)
        | false => let (r, c) := update rest in ((k, v) :: r, c)
    let (new_entries, core_to_destroy) := update reg.entries
    ({ reg with entries := new_entries }, core_to_destroy)

  | Nat.succ _ =>

      | [] => ([], none)
      | (k, v) :: rest =>
        match Nat.beq k id with

        | false => let (r, c) := update rest in ((k, v) :: r, c)
    let (new_entries, core_to_destroy) := update reg.entries
    ({ reg with entries := new_entries }, core_to_destroy)

theorem elementwiseSub_add_cancel {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) : ∀ (a b : List N), a.length = b.length → elementwiseSub sem (elementwiseAdd sem a b) b = a
| [], [], _ => rfl
| a::as, b::bs, h =>
  let f (x : Nat) : Nat := x - 1
  have h_len : as.length = bs.length := congrArg f h
  have h_head : sem.sub (sem.add a b) b = a := sem.sub_add_cancel a b
  have h_tail : elementwiseSub sem (elementwiseAdd sem as bs) bs = as := elementwiseSub_add_cancel sem as bs h_len
  have h_step1 : List.cons (sem.sub (sem.add a b) b) (elementwiseSub sem (elementwiseAdd sem as bs) bs) = List.cons a (elementwiseSub sem (elementwiseAdd sem as bs) bs) := congrArg (fun x => List.cons x (elementwiseSub sem (elementwiseAdd sem as bs) bs)) h_head
  have h_step2 : List.cons a (elementwiseSub sem (elementwiseAdd sem as bs) bs) = List.cons a as := congrArg (List.cons a) h_tail
  Eq.trans h_step1 h_step2
| [], b::bs, h => let f (x : Nat) : Bool := match x with | 0 => true | _ => false in False.elim (Bool.noConfusion (Eq.trans (Eq.symm (congrArg f h)) rfl))
| a::as, [], h => let f (x : Nat) : Bool := match x with | 0 => false | _ => true in False.elim (Bool.noConfusion (Eq.trans (Eq.symm (congrArg f h)) rfl))

| a::as, b::bs, h =>

  have h_step2 : List.cons a (elementwiseDiv sem (elementwiseMul sem as bs) bs) = List.cons a as := congrArg (List.cons a) h_tail

theorem pair_eq {α β : Type} {a c : α} {b d : β} (h1 : a = c) (h2 : b = d) : (a, b) = (c, d) :=

  have s2 : (c, b) = (c, d) := congrArg (fun y => (c, y)) h2
  Eq.trans s1 s2

theorem inverseRow_forwardRow {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (dim : Nat) (cmin cmax : N) (sw tw sb tb x1 x2 : List N)
  (h_len1 : x1.length = (computeScaleRow sem dim cmin cmax sw sb x2).length)
  (h_len2 : x2.length = (computeTranslationRow sem dim tw tb (elementwiseMul sem x1 (computeScaleRow sem dim cmin cmax sw sb x2))).length) :
  inverseRow sem dim cmin cmax sw tw sb tb (forwardRow sem dim cmin cmax sw tw sb tb x1 x2).1 (forwardRow sem dim cmin cmax sw tw sb tb x1 x2).2 = (x1, x2) :=
  let scale := computeScaleRow sem dim cmin cmax sw sb x2
  let y1 := elementwiseMul sem x1 scale
  let trans := computeTranslationRow sem dim tw tb y1
  let y2 := elementwiseAdd sem x2 trans
  have h_x2 : elementwiseSub sem y2 trans = x2 := elementwiseSub_add_cancel sem x2 trans h_len2
  have h_scale : computeScaleRow sem dim cmin cmax sw sb (elementwiseSub sem y2 trans) = scale := congrArg (computeScaleRow sem dim cmin cmax sw sb) h_x2
  have h_x1_step1 : elementwiseDiv sem y1 (computeScaleRow sem dim cmin cmax sw sb (elementwiseSub sem y2 trans)) = elementwiseDiv sem y1 scale := congrArg (elementwiseDiv sem y1) h_scale
  have h_x1_step2 : elementwiseDiv sem y1 scale = x1 := elementwiseDiv_mul_cancel sem x1 scale h_len1
  have h_x1 : elementwiseDiv sem y1 (computeScaleRow sem dim cmin cmax sw sb (elementwiseSub sem y2 trans)) = x1 := Eq.trans h_x1_step1 h_x1_step2
  pair_eq h_x1 h_x2

def registerRegistryCore {Core : Type} (reg : Registry Core) (core : Core) : Registry Core × Nat :=
  let id := reg.next_id
  let new_entry := { core := core, active_ops := 0, destroyed := false : RegistryEntry Core }
  let rec insert_unique (es : List (Nat × RegistryEntry Core)) : List (Nat × RegistryEntry Core) :=
    match es with
    | [] => [(id, new_entry)]
    | (k, v) :: rest => match Nat.beq k id with | true => (id, new_entry) :: rest | false => (k, v) :: insert_unique rest
  ({ entries := insert_unique reg.entries, next_id := id + 1 }, id)

def lookupEntry {Core : Type} : Nat → List (Nat × RegistryEntry Core) → Option (RegistryEntry Core)
| _, [] => none
| k, (k', v) :: rest => match Nat.beq k k' with | true => some v | false => lookupEntry k rest

def acquireRegistryCore {Core : Type} (reg : Registry Core) (id : Nat) : RSFResult Core :=
  match id with
  | 0 => Except.error RSFError.NotInitialized
  | Nat.succ _ =>
    match lookupEntry id reg.entries with
    | none => Except.error RSFError.NotInitialized
    | some entry => match entry.destroyed with | true => Except.error RSFError.NotInitialized | false => Except.ok entry.core

def releaseRegistryCore {Core : Type} (reg : Registry Core) (id : Nat) : Registry Core × Option Core :=
  match id with
  | 0 => (reg, none)
  | Nat.succ _ =>
    let rec update (es : List (Nat × RegistryEntry Core)) : List (Nat × RegistryEntry Core) × Option Core :=
      match es with
      | [] => ([], none)
      | (k, v) :: rest =>
        match Nat.beq k id with
        | true =>
          let new_ops := match v.active_ops with | 0 => 0 | Nat.succ n => n
          match v.destroyed, new_ops with
          | true, 0 => (rest, some v.core)
          | _, _ => ((k, { v with active_ops := new_ops }) :: rest, none)
        | false => let (r, c) := update rest in ((k, v) :: r, c)
    let (new_entries, core_to_destroy) := update reg.entries
    ({ reg with entries := new_entries }, core_to_destroy)

def requestDestroyRegistryCore {Core : Type} (reg : Registry Core) (id : Nat) : Registry Core × Option Core :=
  match id with
  | 0 => (reg, none)

    let rec update (es : List (Nat × RegistryEntry Core)) : List (Nat × RegistryEntry Core) × Option Core :=

      | [] => ([], none)
      | (k, v) :: rest =>
        match Nat.beq k id with
        | true => match v.active_ops with | 0 => (rest, some v.core) | _ => ((k, { v with destroyed := true }) :: rest, none)
        | false => let (r, c) := update rest in ((k, v) :: r, c)
    let (new_entries, core_to_destroy) := update reg.entries
    ({ reg with entries := new_entries }, core_to_destroy)
